task: Cover the flashcards app (`/`): two decks, Spanish basics (hola, gracias, adiós; gracias already learned) and Capitals (Norway, Peru). Study on a deck opens the Study panel titled `Studying <deck>` with the first card's front and `Card 1 of N`. Flip reveals the back. Got it marks the card learned and Again leaves it unlearned; both advance to the next card and the `Card N of M` line follows. After the last card the panel shows `Session done` and `All N cards reviewed`, and the deck's `N cards · M learned` line reflects the learned count. Learned state is stored on the server and survives a reload. Back to decks closes the panel.

faults.find: study.addEventListener("click", () => { session = { deckId: deck.id, index: 0, flipped: false, done: false }; render(); });

faults.brief_phrase: the `Card N of M` line follows
faults.description: The progress line always reads `Card 1 of N` while the cards advance.
Again marks the card learned just like Got it.

faults.brief_phrase: Learned state is stored on the server and survives a reload
